summary: Model artifact + environment: vendor the student checkpoint and the torch dependency as an optional extra
description: Decide the checkpoint home (models/ dir vs pinned path into rellm runs — recommend copying into guru models/derived-parallels/<version>/ with the training card, so the corpus pipeline is self-contained and versioned). torch+transformers as an optional dependency group used only by derive_parallels; document the CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER=PCI_BUS_ID CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 pin for the 3090 and the CPU fallback (~7 min GPU / ~6 min 8-thread CPU int8 for the full corpus).
